propositions: macOS pytest cell runs 3.7x slower per test than Ubuntu due to process-spawn and git-store fixture overhead, becoming the sole long pole in the Gerrit Verified Gate (~2140-2486s on macOS vs ~572-595s on Ubuntu).

Full default suite on macOS buys latency without proportional confidence gain; platform-sensitive tests (file locking, atomic operations, subprocess timeout, cross-process git contention) should be isolated and run separately from the entire breadth.
A centralized path-keyed auto-marker in tests/conftest.py must apply the platform_compat marker to OS-sensitive test files, replacing manual per-file markers to prevent silent suite drift.

Ubuntu continues running the full default suite unchanged; macOS switches to `platform_compat and not external` for the default suite and retains the integration tier step, reducing macOS CI runtime without reducing confidence.
